```{r}
outputdir <- "./figs/"
if(!dir.exists(outputdir)){
  dir.create(outputdir)
}

ggsave2_tri <- function(plot, wid = 9, hei=9){
  plot_name <- deparse(substitute(plot))
  
  #png
  file_name <- paste(outputdir,plot_name, ".png", sep = "",collapse = "")
  ggsave(filename = file_name,plot = plot,device = "png",width = wid, height = hei,dpi = 300,units = "cm")
  
  
  #pdf
  file_name <- paste(outputdir,plot_name, ".pdf", sep = "",collapse = "")
  # ggsave(filename = file_name,plot = plot,device = "pdf",width = wid, height = hei,dpi = 300,units = "cm")
  
  #pptx
  file_name <- paste(outputdir,plot_name, ".pptx", sep = "",collapse = "")
  plot_ed <- rvg::dml(ggobj = plot,width = wid, height = hei)
  
  doc <- read_pptx() %>%
    add_slide('Title and Content', 'Office Theme') %>%
    ph_with(value = "", location = ph_location_type(type = "title")) %>%
    ph_with(value = plot_ed, location = ph_location(type = "body",width = cm2inch(wid), height = cm2inch(hei),left = 2, top = 2))
  doc %>%
    print(target = file_name)
  
}
```

```{r}
  mutate(readmission = if_else(readmission == "Yes", 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(CHF = if_else(CHF == "Yes", 1, 0)) %>%
  mutate(RespF = if_else(RespF == "Yes", 1, 0)) %>%
  mutate(HepatF = if_else(HepatF == "Yes", 1, 0)) %>%

  mutate(AIDS = if_else(AIDS == "Yes", 1, 0)) %>%

  mutate(imm_sup = if_else(imm_sup == "Yes", 1, 0)) %>%
  mutate(onHD = if_else(onHD == "Yes", 1, 0))
```

## 対象リストの作成
対象条件選定＋タイムスタンプの処理＋前後24h,48hのcolumn追加  
df_icuはJIPADから生成された、病棟からの緊急入室のリスト
```{r}
df_icu <- df_icu_org %>% 
  filter(adm_path == "病棟" & adm_type == "緊急"　& adult_ped_categ == "成人") %>%
  # mutate(ADM_DT = lubridate::as_datetime (ADM_DT, origin = "1899-12-30"), tz = "Japan")
  mutate(ADM_DT = as.POSIXct(as.Date(ADM_DT, origin = "1899-12-30"), tz = "Japan")) %>%
  mutate(disc_u_DT = as.POSIXct(as.Date(disc_u_DT, origin = "1899-12-30"), tz = "Japan")) %>%
  mutate(nyuin_day = as.POSIXct(as.Date(nyuin_day, origin = "1899-12-30"))) %>%
  mutate(taiin_day = as.POSIXct(as.Date(taiin_day, origin = "1899-12-30"))) %>%
  mutate(
    ADM_24h_ago = ADM_DT - hours(24),
    ADM_48h_ago = ADM_DT - hours(48)
  )
```

```{r}
df_icu <- df_icu %>%
```

→263行目から、変換はしてみた、表もできた。でもなんか違う？

exclude(unnecessary WARDs & SECTIONs)  
ICU入室1日前のsectionとwardの情報を入手したい  
また、ICU直入や、前日時点でICUにすでにいる患者は除外したい

2024/04/25  ICU直接入院患者と入院後短時間での転床の除外  
df_all_admtcとdf_icuをマージしたあと、ADM_DTとINHOSP_DATE+TIMEの比較を行い、  
これらが完全一致、ないし時間（例えば差分が6時間以内など）で区切る処理  

まずは入院当日ICUについてはJIPAD側=df_icuでの処理   
そのごく一部の患者がICU直入かそれに準ずるかを判別する方針とする  
```{r}
df_direct <- df_icu %>% 
  mutate(ADM_d = as.Date(ADM_DT)) %>%
  filter(ADM_d == nyuin_day)
```

幸い、ADM_DTが日付変わりたての人はいない（最速AM9時台）  
df_all_admtcとdf_icuのマージ後に時間で処理して6時間以上前？まで病棟記録が遡れる人、  
を解析対象者と定義  
除外対象となる入院後6時間以内のICU入室者を抽出
```{r}
df_detect_direct <- df_all_admtc %>% 
  mutate(INHOSPdt = str_c(INHOSP_DATE, INHOSP_TIME, sep=" ") %>%
        lubridate::ymd_hms()) %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(., df_direct %>% 
              dplyr::select(PT_ID, ADM_DT, JIPAD_ID),
              by="PT_ID",relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  dplyr::select(PT_ID, ADM_DT, everything()) %>% 
  mutate(sub_DT=ADM_DT-INHOSPdt) %>% 
  filter(sub_DT>=0) %>% 
  # more→less
  mutate(lessthan_6h=sub_DT<=6*60*60) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(lessthan_6h) %>% 
  mutate(hour = sub_DT/3600) %>% 
  mutate(hrs = as.numeric(hour)) %>% 
  mutate(hrs_int = round(hrs)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(JIPAD_ID, PT_ID, ADM_DT, INHOSPdt, lessthan_6h, hrs_int, everything())
```

```{r}
df_icu %>% 
  filter(!JIPAD_ID %in% unique(df_detect_direct$JIPAD_ID))
```
追加処理（ex_wards, ex_section)が必要 on2024/04/26 
注意点として、以前の139、163入室という数字はdf_icuとadmtcに相当するものを  
マージした上での数字。ここでのdf_icuは未マージ  
と、いうことで    
ICU入室前日のリストを作成し、除外対象上病棟の患者（入院）を除外  
（本プロジェクトでのdf_icuは入室後6時間以内の患者を選別したい  
が、CALENDER_DATE時点でのWARDがどこになるかは処理しきれない）
```{r}
df_daybefore_icu <- df_all_admtc %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(., df_icu %>% 
              dplyr::select(PT_ID, ADM_DT, ADM_24h_ago),
              by="PT_ID",relationship = "many-to-many") %>% 
  mutate(ADM_1dprev = as.Date(ADM_24h_ago)) %>% 
  filter(ADM_1dprev ==CALENDAR_DATE) %>%
  dplyr::select(PT_ID, ADM_1dprev, CALENDAR_DATE, everything())

df_ex_wards <- df_all_admtc %>%
  filter(WARD %in% setting_list$ex_wards) %>%
  mutate(CALENDAR_DATE = as.Date(CALENDAR_DATE))

df_ex_sects <- df_all_admtc %>%
  filter(SECTION %in% setting_list$ex_sects) %>%
  mutate(CALENDAR_DATE = as.Date(CALENDAR_DATE))

df_direct_toicu <- df_all_admtc %>%
  mutate(CALENDAR_DATE = as.Date(CALENDAR_DATE)) %>%
  dplyr::anti_join(df_daybefore_icu %>%
                     mutate(CALENDAR_DATE = as.Date(ADM_DT)),by= c("PT_ID", "CALENDAR_DATE"))

df_icu_target <- df_icu %>%
  mutate(ADM_1dprev = as.Date(ADM_24h_ago)) %>%
  mutate(CALENDAR_DATE = as.Date(ADM_DT)) %>%
  dplyr::anti_join(df_direct_toicu, by= c("PT_ID", "CALENDAR_DATE")) %>%
  dplyr::anti_join(df_ex_wards, by= c("PT_ID"="PT_ID", "ADM_1dprev"="CALENDAR_DATE")) %>%
  dplyr::anti_join(df_ex_sects, by= c("PT_ID"="PT_ID", "ADM_1dprev"="CALENDAR_DATE"))
```
